summary: Profile Avatar feature (backend + frontend) fully verified. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (health, upload, GET webp+ETag+304, invalid base64 422, DELETE, user state includes avatar fields, premium regression). Frontend (390x844 web preview): guest onboarding → Home shows round gradient avatar with initial 'A' next to credits badge (testID home-greeting / home-greeting-name) and PAUSE logo on the left; tap avatar opens Profile tab. Profile avatar (64px, camera badge profile-avatar-edit) shows link 'Add photo' (profile-avatar-change). Tapping the avatar opens the native file chooser; after upload: profile-avatar-photo renders the image, link text becomes 'Change photo' and 'Remove' (profile-avatar-remove) appears. Home header avatar also shows the uploaded photo (home-greeting-photo). Remove clears the fields (DELETE 200) and initial letter + 'Add photo' return. Regression: PAUSE logo, home-credits badge, and /premium screen all render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1400 lines — consider splitting avatar/profile/credits/history endpoints into submodules for maintainability (not a blocker).

set_avatar enforces a client-side size cap (len(b64)>8_000_000 → 413) which is good; the PRD mentions ≤6MB — the current check corresponds to ~6MB raw after base64 overhead (8M b64 ≈ 6M bytes), matches the spec.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_avatar_* and TEST_prem_* ephemeral users for test runs; avatar cleaned up in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_avatar_iter_profile.py and reuse EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Use a browser User-Agent in headers to bypass the preview ingress 403. Frontend testIDs: home-greeting (plus -name / -photo / -edit variants), profile-avatar, profile-avatar-change (text 'Add photo' | 'Change photo'), profile-avatar-remove. Guest onboarding path: fill onboarding-profile-name → onboarding-profile-continue → chip-all → onboarding-continue (web file chooser via Playwright expect_file_chooser).
